extDescription.message: Type clipboard content into web form fields that block pasting.

offscreenJustification.message: Read clipboard text to type it into a web form field

heroSubtitle.message: Type into fields that block pasting

step2.message: Right-click inside a text field on a web page.

usageDesc.message: Typed character by character, like keyboard input. No paste event is fired, so paste blocking does not apply.

modeDescChar.message: Types one character at a time, closest to real keyboard input and most compatible.

modeDescInstant.message: Inserts the whole text at once. Fastest, but some editors may only receive one input event.

delayDisabledTitle.message: Typing delay is not used in whole-text mode

tipLocal.message: · Local only: no network requests, no clipboard storage.

tipLong.message: · Long text is typed in batches; press <kbd>Esc</kbd> to stop.

tipRefresh.message: · Refresh open pages after installing or updating.

noTargetShortcut.message: Place the cursor in a text field, then press the shortcut

noTargetMenu.message: No editable text field found. Click inside a field and try again.

clipboardReadFailed.message: Could not read the clipboard. Copy the text again and retry.

targetNotEditable.message: The target field is not editable right now

unsupported.message: This element does not support simulated input

rejected.message: The field rejected the simulated input; the text may be incomplete.

typedCountTruncated.message: Typed $COUNT$ character(s); the rest was truncated by the field's length limit

longTextBatching.message: Long text detected — typing in batches…
